title: Read quest's terminal statuses from quest task status-flow instead of hardcoding Done (QCLI-331 adds a second terminal status)
description: Filed on opum-agent's dispatch (OPAG-665 AC3, 2026-09-28). ADR read by ref: opum-doc docs/adr/add-a-second-terminal-task-status-for-duplicate-superseded-and-wont-do-outcomes.md at 724fc0959f0b (blob 650c6ea5). quest-cli QCLI-331 adds a second terminal task status with a required resolution (duplicate, superseded, wont-do). Wherever lore reads quest task status to decide completion (Story/Task coupling, lore check, bridges), a hardcoded Done would treat a task closed as duplicate/superseded/wont-do as still open. MEASURE FIRST: count the sites hardcoding Done as terminal, stating how many files were read, with a positive control; grep the bare word, classify after.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A measurement is recorded on this task BEFORE any code change: sites in src/ (and scripts/; test fixtures classified separately) that treat "Done" as the only terminal quest status, with the number of files read, the search used, and a positive control

Every completion decision lore makes from quest task status reads terminalStatuses from `quest task status-flow` (detected by capability presence, not a version comparison), with a stated fallback when the installed quest predates it
A test proves a task in the new terminal status is treated as complete by Story/Task coupling and lore check, and a non-terminal status is not

The adapter accepts a status-flow whose terminalStatuses is a subset of statuses plus closedStatus (quest-cli QCLI-331 shape B, and QCLI-406 later step A), and classifies closedStatus as terminal. A terminal status outside both is still drift, and that drift message names a lore/quest version MISMATCH, not "Quest 0.2.7 or newer is required", which is wrong for a too-new quest. Tests cover shape B (closedStatus present, terminalStatuses [Done]), shape A (terminalStatuses [Done, Closed]) and a genuinely foreign terminal status
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; reviewer pass

implementationNotes: RULING AND COUNTERPART (2026-09-28). quest-cli warned that QCLI-331 shape A (Closed inside terminalStatuses) breaks lore. lore-cli measured it by ref: the throw at src/adapters/quest.ts:681 ('Quest returned terminal statuses outside its status flow') is identical in tag v0.11.0 and, by git log -S, present since the fresh-history root e3d75867. It runs inside probe() (quest.ts:405), which ensure() calls before every quest adapter operation. So shape A with any published lore would break every tracker-touching command, and MIN_QUEST_VERSION 0.2.7 is a floor, not a ceiling. On that measurement opum-agent RE-RULED QCLI-331 to shape B now and A later, verifying probe() :405, ensure() :408/:410 and v0.11.0 :680-681 by ref. Under B, quest's status-flow gains closedStatus 'Closed' and resolutions, and terminalStatuses stays [Done]: shipped lore keeps working, and a Closed record reports statusNotInFlow. COUNTERPART: quest-cli QCLI-406 (opum-ai/quest-cli#385) is the later step A. It moves Closed into terminalStatuses and is BLOCKED on this task becoming the adapter floor consumers actually run. This task is therefore QCLI-406's prerequisite, not the next pair release's. Per opum-agent it keeps its queue place, after LCLI-622 phase 2. Criterion 4 was added for the tolerance rule and the version-mismatch drift message. The ~190 hardcoded 'Done' literals the ADR says are owed to classification are covered by criterion 1: measure before code, classify src/ and scripts/ separately from test fixtures, with a positive control.

SHAPE B MEASURED LIVE by quest-cli, not re-run here (2026-09-28). Published lore 0.11.0 against a quest built from opum-ai/quest-cli#386 head 00c6bbe (QCLI-331 shape B), through a logging quest shim. lore check: exit 0, 146 quest calls. lore tasks stories/audit-quest-cli-documentation-authority: exit 0, 10 calls, output byte-identical to the same command against quest 0.11.0. So probe() passes on published lore under B. The measurement is recorded as a comment on quest-cli#386. lore-cli's own reading (verifyManifest at quest.ts:724 only requires REQUIRED_COMMANDS; statusFlow at :676 passes when terminal is a subset of statuses) agrees. PRIORITY per opum-agent: this task gates quest-cli QCLI-406, so it must not slip behind LCLI-634 to 636.
